units.text: 1. A civil servant's professional service activities shall be carried out in accordance with official duties regulations approved by the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 36

units.text: 2. The official duties regulations shall include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 1) qualification requirements for holding the civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 2) official duties; 3) the list of matters on which the civil servant may or must independently take managerial and other decisions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 4) the list of matters on which the civil servant may or must participate in drafting regulatory legal acts and/or managerial and other decisions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 5) time limits and procedures for preparing and considering draft managerial and other decisions, and the procedure for coordinating and adopting those decisions;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 6) the procedure for a civil servant’s official interaction, in connection with the performance of official duties, with civil servants of the same state body, civil servants of other state bodies, other citizens and organizations;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 7) the list of state services provided by the civil servant to citizens and organizations in accordance with the state body’s administrative regulations;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 8) indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of the civil servant’s professional service activities, determined on the basis of general and specific indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions. Specific indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions are approved by an act of the state body in accordance with the particular nature of its tasks and functions. They are determined on the basis of the general indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of state bodies’ activities, the adoption and implementation of managerial and other decisions, and the legal, organizational and documentary support for implementation of those decisions, which are common to state bodies and civil servants and approved, respectively, by the President of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 36

units.text: 3. The provisions of the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when conducting a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve, when making an appointment to a civil service position without a competition, during attestation, and when planning the civil servant's professional service activities and professional development.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 36

units.text: 4. A civil servant's compliance with the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when they participate in a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or are included in the state body's personnel reserve, when they are appointed to a civil service position without a competition, and when their professional service activities are assessed during attestation or when an incentive is granted.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 36

units.text: 5. Model official duties regulations are approved by the state service management body.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 36

units.text: Article 37. Appraisal of civil servants
units.label: Art. 37

units.text: 1. A civil servant is appraised to determine their suitability for the civil service position held; the appraisal includes an assessment of their professional service activities and their professional level.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 37

units.text: 2. During an appraisal, the civil servant’s immediate supervisor submits a reasoned review of the civil servant’s performance of official duties over the appraisal period. The reasoned review is accompanied by information, contained in the civil servant’s annual reports on professional service activities, about instructions carried out and draft documents prepared during the appraisal period and, where necessary, the civil servant’s explanatory note responding to the immediate supervisor’s review.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 37

units.text: 3. Civil servants holding positions in the ‘managers’ category under fixed-term service contracts, and civil servants holding positions in the ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, are not subject to appraisal.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 37

units.text: 4. A civil servant is appraised once every three years.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 37

units.text: 5. An extraordinary attestation of a civil servant may be conducted before the time specified in part 4 of this Article after a decision has been adopted under the established procedure:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 37

units.text: 1) to reduce the number of civil service positions in the state body;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 37

units.text: 2) to change the conditions of civil servants' remuneration.
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 37

units.text: 6. By agreement of the parties to the service contract, an extraordinary appraisal of the civil servant may also be conducted, taking account of the results of the annual report on professional service activities prepared in accordance with the official duties regulations. Before approval of the official duties regulations, an extraordinary appraisal is conducted taking account of the results of the civil servant’s professional service activities as determined by the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 37

units.text: 7. Appraisal takes account of the civil servant’s observance of restrictions, absence of violations of prohibitions, and fulfilment of requirements for official conduct and obligations established by federal law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 37

units.text: 8. A civil servant on maternity leave or leave to care for a child until the child reaches three years of age shall undergo attestation no earlier than one year after returning from leave.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 37

units.text: 9. An appraisal commission is established by an act of the state body to appraise civil servants.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 37

units.text: 10. The appraisal commission includes the employer’s representative and/or civil servants authorized by that representative (including from the subdivision responsible for state service and personnel matters and the subdivision in which the civil servant being appraised holds a position), as well as independent experts included in the commission in accordance with part 10.2 of Article 48 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations who are specialists in the relevant fields and types of civil servants’ professional service activities and in personnel technologies and civil service matters. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the appraisal commission. An independent expert’s term on the appraisal commission is determined in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 37

units.text: 10.1. In an executive authority of the City of Moscow at which a public council has been established in accordance with a legal act of the City of Moscow, the appraisal commission includes representatives of that public council in addition to the persons specified in part 10 of this Article. Those representatives and independent experts together must constitute at least one quarter of all members of the appraisal commission.
units.label: Part 10.1 Art. 37

units.text: 11. For the appraisal of civil servants holding positions whose official duties involve the use of state secrets, the appraisal commission is formed taking account of the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 37

units.text: 12. The appraisal commission is formed so as to exclude the possibility of a conflict of interest capable of influencing decisions taken by the commission.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 37

units.text: 13. While a civil servant who is a member of the attestation commission is undergoing attestation, their membership of the commission shall be suspended.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 37

units.text: 14. If a civil servant fails to attend an appraisal without valid reasons or refuses to undergo appraisal, the civil servant is subject to disciplinary liability in accordance with federal law and Article 46 of this Law, and the appraisal is postponed.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 37

units.text: 15. Following a civil servant's attestation, the attestation commission shall adopt one of the following decisions:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 37

units.text: 1) suitable for the civil service position held;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 37

units.text: 2) suitable for the civil service position held and recommended for inclusion in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 37

units.text: 3) suitable for the civil service position held, subject to successful completion of additional professional education; 4) unsuitable for the civil service position held.
units.label: Point 3 Part 15 Art. 37

units.text: 16. Within one month after the appraisal, on the basis of its results, an act of the state body is issued stating that the civil servant:
units.label: Part 16 Art. 37

units.text: 1) is to be included in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;
units.label: Point 1 Part 16 Art. 37

units.text: 2) is to be sent for further professional education;
units.label: Point 2 Part 16 Art. 37

units.text: 3) is to be demoted in civil service and removed from the personnel reserve if included in it.
units.label: Point 3 Part 16 Art. 37

units.text: 17. If a civil servant refuses additional professional education or transfer to another civil service position, the employer’s representative may release the civil servant from the position held and dismiss them from the civil service in accordance with the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 37

units.text: 18. A civil servant may challenge the appraisal results in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 37

units.text: Chapter 9. Remuneration of civil servants
units.label: Chapter 9. Remuneration of civil servants

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant’s professional service activities are remunerated in the form of monetary remuneration, which is the principal means of their financial support and of incentivizing professional service activities in the civil service position held.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant’s monetary remuneration consists of the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service position held (hereinafter referred to as the position salary) and the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service class rank conferred (hereinafter referred to as the class-rank salary), which together constitute the civil servant’s monthly remuneration salary (hereinafter referred to as the remuneration salary), as well as monthly and other additional payments (hereinafter referred to as additional payments).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 3. The amounts of civil servants’ position salaries and class-rank salaries are established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 4. Additional payments include: 1) a monthly allowance to the position salary for length of civil service, in the following amounts:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: Length of civil service | percentage: from 1 year to 5 years | 10; from 5 to 10 years | 15; from 10 to 15 years | 20; over 15 years | 30. 2) a monthly allowance to the position salary for special civil service conditions of up to 200 percent of that salary; 3) a monthly percentage allowance to the position salary for work with state secrets, in the amounts and according to the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts;
units.label: Part 4 Art. 39 · “Length of civil service | percentage: from 1 year to 5 years |…”

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 4) bonuses for performing particularly important and complex tasks, taking account of support for the state body’s tasks and functions and compliance with the official duties regulations (no maximum amount is set);
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 5) monthly monetary incentives; 6) a lump-sum payment upon the granting of annual paid leave and material assistance, paid from the state body’s civil servants’ remuneration fund.
units.label: Point 5 Part 4 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 5. The procedure and conditions for bonuses for performing particularly important and complex tasks, payment of the monthly allowance to the position salary for special civil service conditions, and the lump-sum payment upon the granting of annual paid leave and material assistance from the state body’s civil servants’ remuneration fund are determined by the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 6. The amounts of monthly monetary incentives paid to civil servants are established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow when determining the funds allocated for those purposes in forming the state body’s civil servants’ remuneration fund.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 7. Remuneration salaries for civil service positions are increased (indexed) annually in accordance with the City of Moscow law on the budget of the City of Moscow for the relevant year, taking account of inflation (consumer prices). Increases (indexation) within the funds provided for by the City of Moscow law on the budget of the City of Moscow are made in accordance with the procedure and time limits established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 8. Civil servants receive other payments provided for by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Remuneration for the professional service activities of a civil servant
units.text: 9. In cases provided for by federal law, civil servants may also receive monetary remuneration from the federal budget.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.label: Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 1. The remuneration fund for civil servants and employees of a state body consists of the civil servants’ remuneration fund and the remuneration fund for employees holding positions that are not civil service positions.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 2. When forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund, the following funds are provided, in addition to the funds allocated for position salaries, for the following payments (calculated per year):
units.label: Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 1) class-rank salaries — four position salaries;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 2) the monthly allowance to the position salary for length of civil service — three position salaries;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 3) the monthly allowance to the position salary for special civil service conditions — fourteen position salaries; 4) the monthly percentage allowance to the position salary for work with state secrets — one and a half position salaries;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 5) bonuses for performing particularly important and complex tasks — two remuneration salaries;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 6) monthly monetary incentives — in the amount established for civil servants by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 7) the lump-sum payment upon the granting of annual paid leave and material assistance — three remuneration salaries.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 40
